title: Keeping the beings out of the official report to protect his Personnel Reliability Program status

tellings.quote: had I said that I saw these beings they would have immediately removed me from the PE RP personal reliability program

plain: In 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a nuclear weapons guard named Mario Woods says he saw beings during an encounter he describes as an abduction, but he kept them out of his official report. He says that if he had reported the beings, he would have been removed right away from the Personnel Reliability Program, the screening that clears people to work around nuclear weapons. So in his account, the official record leaves out what he says he saw.
